# oneuptime_ai_agent_task_log (Resource)

Ai agent task log resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_ai_agent_task_log" "example" {
  ai_agent_task_id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
  ai_agent_id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
  severity = "Example short text"
  message = "This is an example of very long text content that might be stored in this field. It can contain a lot of information, such as detailed descriptions, comments, or any other lengthy text data that needs to be stored in the database."
}
```
